problem: The existing UI hid unresolved facet controls after a known-value narrowing, reported no scoped reason for uniform or unknown-only dimensions, and let accepted fixture filtering return the unfiltered response. Live facet labels also came from raw IDs, so values absent from the current page could not use captured source or capability names. The frozen discovery-result v1.0.0 schema cannot accept new option fields or section metadata.
resulting_behavior: Canonical source, geography, access_status, unit_of_analysis and capability facets are projected into browser-only availability/reason metadata. Unknown geography/access controls remain usable without fabricated counts; selected values survive narrowed and empty responses and remain removable. Existing count values remain current matching records before pagination for live responses, while filtered fixture counts are explicitly bounded to accepted fixture records. FixtureDiscoveryProvider applies same-dimension OR and cross-dimension AND filters and keeps response pagination/ranking/sections consistent. Retrieval-core changes only existing facet option label strings, resolving unambiguous captured source/capability names from complete matches and using readable bounded labels for known IDs. Frozen schemas, types, reference engines, manifests, fingerprints and source bytes are unchanged.
